propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall hierarchy

fetch_snapshot's three enrichment re-raise clauses match on BackendPaginationStallError and miss Cloud's error, causing control to fall through to broad except Exception handlers that log a warning and degrade
A stalled Cloud cursor produces a silently degraded snapshot with missing parents and links instead of propagating the error and aborting the pass
The fix changes RunawayPaginationError to subclass BackendPaginationStallError, preserving RuntimeError in the MRO and making all three fetcher re-raise clauses cover Cloud stalls automatically
Held-out tests verify stalls propagate through all three enrichment readers and ordinary non-stall failures still fail open and degrade
